description:
Rowan Fitzgerald Auctioneers are delighted to introduce to the market this substantial, detached bungalow in Ardnacrusha which sits just a few kilometers from Limerick City. 28 Parkroe Heights will provide you with an opportunity to enjoy countryside living without being isolated from the City and all of its facilities. The property sits on just over half an acre of ground from which you can enjoy peace and tranquility and beautiful riverside walks are just a few minutes away.  Blackwater is a beautiful countryside setting while never far from modern day amenities and facilities. Only a short commute to Limerick City, Killaloe and O'Briens Bridge. There are a number of both primary and secondary schools close by. Aside from the convenient location, it is the beauty and vibrancy of the natural landscape that attracts buyers to the area. Transport links include M7, N18
On entering this family home, you will be immediately struck by the sense of space & privacy. A long entrance hallway commences the accommodation with tiled flooring through; To the left, brings you to the living room a welcoming fireplace keeping you cosy on those cold winter evenings. Beside the living room is a kitchen/dining area, giving the benefit of overlooking the gardens and instils a wonderful sense of tranquillity and privacy. The modern kitchen has plenty of floor/ wall units for space & storage along with tiled flooring that carries through to the utility which is fully plumbed and has access to the rear garden & a guest WC. The second living area or sun room is bright & spacious. Further down the hallway are four bedrooms, master bedroom boasts an en-suite and the main family bathroom completes the accommodation. The property also boasts a large garage suitable for conversion (subject to planning) & could further enhance the accommodation!
Approached by a stone gated driveway, there is ample off street car parking with a lawned front garden along with side access to rear. The private rear garden that is divided with patio areas, bordered by trees, hedging & lawns.
Early viewing is a must!  For more information or to arrange a viewing, please call Rachael on 061-279423 or email reply to this advert.
